02 From the floor

Small shop, loud machines

FORGE 7 started in a rented garage with one welder and a borrowed plasma table. Today it is three people in a brick shed behind the old rail yard, still making everything the slow way: measured twice, cut once, welded by hand.

We build for kitchens, studios, cafés and living rooms. Every table has a weld seam you can find if you look for it, and we leave it there on purpose. It is how you know a person made it.

03 The line

Four stations, one piece

  1. Step 01

    Measure

    We visit, sketch and agree on every millimetre.

  2. Step 02

    Cut

    Plasma and saw turn sheet and tube into parts.

  3. Step 03

    Weld

    Joints are welded by hand, then ground to feel right.

  4. Step 04

    Finish

    Wax, oil or powder coat, then delivery to your door.
